sources.entry: Torchat-Mac - TorChat for Mac is a macOS native and unofficial port of torchat.

summary.one_liner: TorChat-Mac is an unofficial, macOS-native port of TorChat, a peer-to-peer chat application that runs over Tor hidden services.
